name: celeba
source: CelebA (Liu, Luo, Wang, Tang, 'Deep Learning Face Attributes in the Wild', ICCV 2015; MMLAB, CUHK, http://mmlab.ie.cuhk.edu.hk/projects/CelebA.html). In-the-wild images: the official 14-part archive Img/img_celeba.7z (parts dated 2022-05-31, 734,003,200 B each except the last) obtained via the third-party HF mirror https://huggingface.co/datasets/noname110/celeba (revision 438b96fa79375870b726cd408a3da1eda4f074c4; Google-Drive export zips CelebA-20240106T040341Z-0NN.zip, LFS sha256 listed in raw/hf_noname110.sha256; the mirror's 'apache-2.0' tag is not the dataset licence), extracted to img_celeba/ (202,599 JPEG). archives/img_align_celeba.zip -> img_align_celeba/. Anno/ (identity_CelebA.txt = the identity labels the authors release on request, list_landmarks_celeba.txt 5-point landmarks of the labelled face in the in-the-wild images, bbox, attributes), Eval/list_eval_partition.txt, README.txt (official).

counts.used_by: E2 identity source (img_celeba, full detect -> align -> embed pipeline); E6 subset

notes: IDENTITY-OVERLAP CAVEAT: CelebA identities are celebrities (CelebFaces); the recognizers' training sets (WebFace260M subsets WebFace12M/WebFace600K/WebFace42M, Glint360K: celebrity web images) are built from celebrity name lists, so many CelebA identities are very likely in the training data -> E2 numbers on CelebA are optimistic for unseen customers. Identity labels are known to contain noise (mislabelled / duplicate identities), which inflates both FNIR and FPIR slightly. Landmark annotations (image-left eye first) are used only to pick which detected face is the labelled one. Measured in E2 (2026-10-11): identity labels are substantially noisy for 1:N use - the 4-model consensus found 243 identity pairs with centroid cosine >= 0.45 (one person split over several ids; 235 ids dropped) and 3,608 of 180,832 CelebA probe images (2.0%) whose best other identity scored like a mate (dropped); see reports/E2_1N/cleaning.json. SCRFD-34G found the labelled face in 202,461 / 202,599 in-the-wild images.
